title: Grilled Tuna over Arugula with Lemon Vinaigrette
description: Seared sashimi-grade tuna over peppery arugula with capers and a simple lemon dressing.
steps: Sear the tuna 1 minute per side in a very hot pan, leaving the center rare.
Toss the arugula with lemon juice and oil, top with the tuna and capers.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste grilled tuna over arugula

notes: A genuinely 10-minute dinner — just make sure the tuna is truly sashimi-grade before searing it rare.
